cues: An assembler aligns a pointed blade with a screw head, then rotates the handle to fasten a cabinet hinge.
Turning the handle clockwise draws a threaded fastener snugly into a pilot hole in a wooden board.
To remove a stubborn screw, a repairer applies steady downward pressure while slowly reversing its rotation.
Clouds gathered over the harbor, tinting the water silver as evening boats returned to shore.
Wild orchids bloom beneath the canopy, attracting moths after sunset with their pale, fragrant petals.
A baker folds cold butter into flour until the pastry develops delicate, flaky layers.
